Structure: Sections and divs as real Etch elements with classes, never raw HTML pasted into a block
Type Tokens: ACSS text tokens — var(--text-l, 20px) with a px or em fallback
Color Tokens: ACSS 3 color variables, never hex. Brand ramps var(--primary), var(--secondary), var(--accent), each -ultra-light through -ultra-dark plus -hover. Neutrals var(--neutral-ultra-light) through var(--neutral-ultra-dark). Text on light surfaces var(--text-dark) and var(--text-dark-muted), on dark surfaces var(--text-light) and var(--text-light-muted). Borders var(--border-color-dark) on light surfaces, var(--border-color-light) on dark — it is white at 20% and vanishes on a light background. --base-* and --bg-* follow the brand color, so they are not neutrals
Do: Build the element tree through the etchwp-pro skill so it validates and persists correctly
Do Not: Never emit a Custom HTML block. Never use clamp() for font size

Color Tokens: Where ACSS is active, ACSS 3 color variables, never hex. Brand ramps var(--primary), var(--secondary), var(--accent), each -ultra-light through -ultra-dark plus -hover. Neutrals var(--neutral-ultra-light) through var(--neutral-ultra-dark). Text on light surfaces var(--text-dark) and var(--text-dark-muted), on dark surfaces var(--text-light) and var(--text-light-muted). Borders var(--border-color-dark) on light surfaces, var(--border-color-light) on dark — it is white at 20% and vanishes on a light background. --base-* and --bg-* follow the brand color, so they are not neutrals. Without ACSS, Bricks color palette entries
Spacing: ACSS space tokens or Bricks spacing controls
Do: Assign global classes rather than element-level styling so the site stays editable
Do Not: Do not style inline on elements; it fragments the design system

Structure: Containers (flexbox) with widgets — not the legacy section/column pair
Type Tokens: Elementor global typography where set, else theme fonts
Color Tokens: Elementor global colors — Primary, Secondary, Text, Accent
Do: Use Global Colors and Global Fonts so a later change reaches every page
Do Not: Do not use the legacy section/column structure for new pages

Type Tokens: Kadence typography attributes, or theme.json sizes
Color Tokens: Kadence palette colors from Global Settings, never hex
Do: Go through the kadence-pro skill so uniqueIDs and nesting validate
Do Not: Do not write raw HTML into post content

Structure: Core blocks — group, columns, cover, heading, paragraph, buttons, image

Do: Reference theme.json slugs rather than hex values so the site's own settings win
